name: wechatpy-atomic-shared-quota-windows
instr:
wechatpy cannot coordinate outbound WeChat request budgets across workers and protocol clients. Build storage-backed quota windows with shared bucket identities and ordered policies. Denied work must never reach the network, while unconfigured producers keep their existing arguments, retries, signing, validation, responses, and exceptions.

Reservations must be atomic across MemoryStorage, RedisStorage, and MemcachedStorage. Concurrent bucket use shares one fixed-window limit and deterministic reset boundary; capacity resets only after expiration. Decisions report the committed grant, remaining capacity, and reset boundary. Denials report zero remaining without changing quota or unrelated session state. Preserve storage lookup, assignment, deletion, prefixing, expiration, and serialization behavior.

QuotaController applies the first matching QuotaPolicy in policy order. Unmatched requests remain unrestricted and create no persistent quota state. `QuotaExceeded` is a Exception carrying the denied QuotaDecision.

Every emitted attempt from BaseWeChatClient, WeChatOAuth, BaseWeChatComponent, ComponentOAuth, WeChatPay v2, and WeChatPayV3 consumes one reservation from its resolved bucket, including official credential retries and v3 certificate downloads. Local-only work consumes none. Producers and controllers sharing a backend, namespace, and bucket share one limit. WeChatPayV3 remains importable from wechatpy.pay.v3 and exposes the same quota-controller configuration surface.
